attributes.name: restaurant_id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for each restaurant.

attributes.name: cuisine
attributes.description: The type of cuisine served at the restaurant.

attributes.name: price_range
attributes.description: The price range of the restaurant, categorized as cheap, moderate, or expensive.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The area or neighborhood where the restaurant is located.

attributes.name: address
attributes.description: The full address of the restaurant.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: The postal code of the restaurant's location.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The contact phone number of the restaurant.

attributes.name: booking_reference
attributes.description: A unique reference number for each reservation made at the restaurant.

attributes.name: booking_time
attributes.description: The time and date of the reservation.

attributes.name: booking_people
attributes.description: The number of people for whom the reservation is made.
